# El Cajon Appraiser (www.elcajon.pro)

> El Cajon-focused sister site of Brian Ward Appraisal (brianward.com). Private-party residential appraisals (no lender/loan work) for El Cajon and all of San Diego County by Brian Ward, California Certified Residential Real Estate Appraiser since 2004, 7,000+ appraisals.

- Phone: (760) 483-3339
- Email: contact@elcajon.pro
- Office: 15877 Paseo Del Sur, San Diego, CA
- Order: https://www.elcajon.pro/contact/

## Fees (starting)
- Basic Desktop: from $299 (anywhere in California)
- Desktop: from $449 (anywhere in California)
- Desktop 2-4 Unit: from $549 (anywhere in California)
- Drive-By: from $649 (in-person communities only)
- Standard: from $699 (in-person communities only)
- Standard 2-4 Unit: from $799 (in-person communities only)
- Add-ons: laser measurement $35 per 1,500 sq ft; rush +30%.

## Inspection area
Drive-By and Standard reports only in Brian Ward Appraisal's 68 in-person communities (33 San Diego County incl. El Cajon, 35 Riverside County). Everywhere else in California: desktop reports only.

## Purposes
- [Date-of-Death Appraisal](https://www.elcajon.pro/valuations/date-of-death/): Retrospective home values tied to the exact date a person passed.
- [Estate and Trust Appraisal](https://www.elcajon.pro/valuations/estate-and-trust/): Independent home values for trustees, executors and beneficiaries.
- [Divorce Appraisal](https://www.elcajon.pro/valuations/divorce/): Neutral home values for dividing community property in a divorce.
- [Bankruptcy Appraisal](https://www.elcajon.pro/valuations/bankruptcy/): Home values as of the petition date for bankruptcy schedules.
- [Property Tax and Prop 19 Appraisal](https://www.elcajon.pro/valuations/property-tax-prop-19/): Market value support for assessment appeals and Prop 19 transfers.
- [Family Transfer Appraisal](https://www.elcajon.pro/valuations/family-transfer/): Fair-market values for selling or gifting a home within family.
- [Pre-Purchase Appraisal](https://www.elcajon.pro/valuations/pre-purchase/): An independent value check before a buyer commits to a price.
- [Pre-Listing Appraisal](https://www.elcajon.pro/valuations/pre-listing/): Know the market value before choosing a list price.
- [Insurance Claim Appraisal](https://www.elcajon.pro/valuations/insurance-claim/): Value documentation for property claims and policy disputes.
- [Bail Bond Property Appraisal](https://www.elcajon.pro/valuations/bail-bond/): Equity documentation when real property secures a bail bond.
- [Expert Witness and Litigation Appraisal](https://www.elcajon.pro/valuations/expert-witness/): Appraisals and testimony prepared for disputes and court.
- [USCIS Form I-864 Home Equity Appraisal](https://www.elcajon.pro/valuations/i-864-immigration/): Home equity support for Affidavit of Support asset requirements.
